clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me as President of the United States, 
Executive Order No. 1023 of February 6, 
1909, reserving certain land near the 
town of Rampart, Alaska, as a site for 
an agricultural experiment station, is 
hereby revoked.
This order shall become effective on 
the ninetieth day from the date hereof.
